description: This file defines an interface named WeightedEvaluation used for computing weighted statistical evaluations over arrays, including methods for evaluating over entire arrays or specified subarrays, with input validation and exception handling.

classes.name: WeightedEvaluation
classes.description: Interface for weighted statistical evaluation providing methods to evaluate a statistic over an array of values with corresponding weights, possibly over a subarray, with necessary input validation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the weighted statistic over the entire array of values with the given weights.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the weighted statistic over a specified subarray of values, starting at index 'begin' and spanning 'length' elements, with corresponding weights.
